extracted.name: Savory Vegetable Beef Stew
extracted.description: This savory beef stew is hearty, warm, and packed with potatoes, carrots, peppers, and onions. The delicately spiced, thick sauce will warm up the whole family on cold nights.
ingredient_lines: 3 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 green bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice
instruction_lines: Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat; cook and stir beef and Italian dressing in the hot pot until meat is evenly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in 2 cups water, diced tomatoes, broth, tomato sauce, bouillon, bay leaf, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Add potatoes, carrots, bell pepper, and onion to the pot; cover and continue to simmer until vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes.
Combine flour and 3 tablespoons cold water in a small bowl; mix until smooth. Stir into stew and bring to a boil; cook and stir until thickened, about 2 minutes. Discard bay leaf before serving.
